purpose: Shortlist concrete maintained parent implementations that plausibly satisfy the already frozen per-campaign comparator roles. This audit does not bind any implementation as strongest; binding requires exact version/commit/configuration, a matched-resource adapter, and a campaign-specific fit/limitation test.
selection_rules: prefer maintained native/production implementations over ORION-V2-authored transparent references
do not choose one framework merely for vocabulary similarity or convenience
compose multiple parent implementations when no single product preserves all required scientific roles
record a limitation whenever a candidate lacks authority, semantics, gluing, non-identifiability, selective reopening or protected evaluation required by the campaign
a candidate becomes bound only after exact version/configuration identity and matched-budget adapter are frozen before paired outcomes

fit: LangGraph provides low-level long-running stateful agent orchestration with persistence/memory and controlled deterministic+agentic workflows
Temporal provides durable crash-recoverable workflow execution across failures
Prefect provides explicit workflow state, retries, timeouts and recoverable orchestration as a simpler control
limitations: none natively defines ORION scientific authority or coupled-decomposition correctness
decomposition and honest scientific terminal semantics require a frozen adapter and hostile controls

fit: production-oriented modular pipelines, retrievers, agents and tools
directed multigraph pipelines support branching, simultaneous flows and loops
retriever families include sparse and dense approaches, useful for heterogeneous route controls
limitations: route censoring, evidence-of-absence discipline and exact source/provenance receipts are not guaranteed by default
scholarly source corpus/provider identity must be separately frozen

fit: GROBID converts technical/scientific PDFs into structured TEI/XML with bibliographic/reference structure
scispaCy supplies scientific/biomedical NLP pipelines and entity-oriented processing
limitations: scispaCy is strongest in biomedical/scientific text and is not a universal cross-domain claim extractor
neither package alone guarantees atomic claim scope, reference identity resolution, representation mapping or evidence-binding semantics
PARITY-C remains a known source-coverage gap requiring held-out native semantic cases

fit: NetworkX provides mature graph structures, composition and structural algorithms
RDFLib provides RDF graph creation/parsing/querying/merging
pySHACL validates RDF graphs against explicit SHACL constraints and can apply SHACL rules
limitations: graph composition/constraint validation is not equivalent to local-to-global scientific gluing or obstruction
plural justified portraits and search-universe expansion require an explicit adapter and held-out cases
PARITY-D remains a known source-coverage gap

fit: pyAgrum provides Bayesian/graphical-model representation, exact/approximate inference, learning and causal models
BoTorch provides Bayesian optimization for adaptively selecting expensive evaluations under uncertainty
Ax supplies a production-oriented adaptive experimentation layer above optimization methods
limitations: responsibility topology, interaction-only fault semantics and scientific authority are not supplied automatically
diagnostic model and experiment-space construction must be frozen per case before outcome access

fit: PROV Python implements the W3C PROV data model and serializations for explicit provenance lineage
DVC versions data/experiments and codifies reproducible pipelines tied to Git identities
together they provide strong provenance/configuration/reproducibility parents for change and reopening controls
limitations: selective reopening by alternative support family and minimal scientific reframe are not native DVC/PROV operations
authority non-amplification and scientific repair level selection remain explicit adapter responsibilities

fit: active-learning review workflow directly studies efficient coverage of relevant literature
documentation exposes stopping criteria and explicitly discusses model switching/different vocabulary after a stopping threshold
this is a strong native parent for route coverage, omission challenge and bounded stopping controls
limitations: the ideal stopping threshold remains an active research problem and user-configured threshold is not universal saturation
ASReview literature-screening saturation does not cover every ORION scientific saturation axis

fit: Inspect provides datasets, agents/solvers, scorers, model/provider routing, execution limits, sandboxing, eval sets, retries and log analysis
Inspect can bridge arbitrary external agents and supports human baselining/intervention
DVC can bind/version case data, parameters and experiment artifacts for reproducible custody
limitations: framework-integrity and data/version custody do not themselves establish independent scientific correctness
evaluator independence/dependence disposition and criterion custody still require the frozen ORION-V2 custody protocol

fit: Temporal supplies durable recovery from crashes/network/infrastructure failures
Inspect supplies sandboxed tool execution, limits, agent/provider bridges and evaluation transcripts
LangGraph supplies long-running stateful agent orchestration with persistence and memory
limitations: negative-experience retention and mandatory-context non-truncation are not guaranteed merely by durable execution
provider/tool identity, retry semantics, context budgets and scientific-vs-execution failure separation must remain explicitly frozen

cross_campaign_findings: no single maintained framework currently covers all nine campaign roles without semantic loss
the strongest comparator should therefore be composed per campaign under one matched resource/custody adapter
Inspect AI is a strong evaluator/execution substrate candidate but must not be treated as scientific authority
Temporal/LangGraph/Prefect are execution-orchestration parents, not substitutes for scientific contract or authority semantics
ASReview provides unusually direct native stopping/changed-vocabulary controls for PARITY-G but cannot establish universal ORION saturation
PARITY-C and PARITY-D still require protected native cases because candidate software coverage is structurally incomplete

next_required: choose exact version/commit and configuration per campaign
run pre-outcome known-answer fit tests against the frozen comparator role
record rejected alternatives and why they are weaker or mismatched
freeze resulting implementation registry before protected V1/V2 outcomes
